article.title: Welcome to ZuviloAI
article.summary: A quick orientation to the academy.
article.body:
## Welcome

ZuviloAI is a structured school for Vedic astrology. Every course follows the same shape: chapters, lessons, an assignment and an assessment.

- Browse courses from **Explore**
- Track progress from **My learning**
- Earn a certificate once you finish

article.title: How enrolment works
article.summary: Enrolling in a course and what happens next.
article.body:
## Enrolling

Open any published course and select **Enroll**. Your progress, notes and bookmarks are tracked automatically from your first lesson.
